contract.purpose: Make the public release surface consistently MAGRA-first while preserving upstream Reasonix attribution.
contract.scope: README, package metadata, badges, release checklist, changelog, NOTICE, install commands, and user-facing docs.

interfaces.interface-1: README.md MAGRA install and usage sections
interfaces.interface-2: package.json repository, bugs, homepage, bin, files, and description

invariants.invariant-1: Primary install and launch examples use `magra`.
invariants.invariant-2: Reasonix appears as upstream attribution or compatibility wording only.
invariants.invariant-3: Release docs point to MAGRA artifacts and verification gates.
